The path is relative to the folder of the exe: empty means next to the exe, data/patch a subfolder, ../ one level up, but never outside the game. If the file already exists, DeckDrop asks first and keeps the very first version next to it as .bak. A patch archive can be unpacked here too: DeckDrop shows what it would change before doing it.

set.mega.hint_html: mega.nz links work like any other. Mega encrypts files in the browser and the key is part of the link after the #, so copy the whole link or there is nothing to decrypt with. The file arrives encrypted and is decrypted right on the Deck. A folder link opens a list: tick what to download and it comes down as one game with all its folders. Files download one at a time, since Mega dislikes several connections from one address.
set.mega.verify: Verify the Mega checksum after downloading
set.net.hint_html: The proxy is used by DeckDrop only, the rest of the Deck goes online as usual. It helps when your provider cuts connections to VNDB. Format: socks5://host:port or http://host:port, a login is allowed: socks5://user:pass@host:port. If a PC at home runs a VPN client with a local SOCKS5 port, the address of that PC works, e.g. socks5://192.168.1.10:10808 (allow connections from the local network in the client).
set.net.proxy_downloads: Download games through the proxy too (slower, but gets around blocked file hosts)
set.net.proxy_hidden: The proxy login and password are never shown or sent to the page without the PIN.
